{{Top|leg}}
The '''cookslot''' was a common household appliance which created baked squares tailored to the nutritional requirements of the user's species. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] apartment on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] featured a small cookslot.
